summary: Scaling champion who farms Q stacks early and becomes a huge threat late. He's weak at levels 1–5, so the plan is to deny stacks, punish every last-hit attempt, and win before his scaling matters.
threats: Q (Siphoning Strike) gains permanent damage on every kill. Each stack he gets makes the late game harder for you.
W (Wither) slows your movement and attack speed, increasing over time.
E (Spirit Fire) lowers your armor in its area.
R (Fury of the Sands) at 5 gives bonus HP and armor/MR, plus a damage aura.

matchups.why: Darius bullies Nasus out of lane: every time Nasus walks up to Q a creep, he's in E pull range. Darius out-damages him heavily early and denies his stacks.
trading: Pull him with E when he walks up to stack Q.
Stack Hemorrhage with W and autos; he can't trade back early.
Hit him with the outer edge of Q for bonus damage and healing.
Back off when he Withers you; your attack speed drops.
matchups.early: Bully him at levels 1–3 and deny Q stacks; he can't trade back before his first item.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R resets on kill. His R makes him tankier, so execute before he uses it.
matchups.wave: Freeze near your tower so he has to walk up to farm.
matchups.jungle: Wither is his only defensive tool. Gank when it's on cooldown.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Rush damage; add armor only if his Wither + E trades start hurting.

matchups.why: Renekton's early E-W-Q burst out-damages Nasus and zones him off stacks. Renekton wins the lane decisively if he trades every time Nasus walks up.
trading: E in, W stun, Q, then recast E to dash out, ideally when he walks up to stack.
Use full Fury for the empowered W stun.
Don't stay in after the trade; his Wither slows your escape if you linger.
Freeze the wave and zone him so he can't walk up for stacks.
matchups.early: Bully him at levels 1–3 and deny Q stacks; take plates when he backs.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R makes all-ins stronger. Kill him before his R and stacks catch up.
matchups.wave: Freeze near your tower so he must walk through your E range.
matchups.jungle: His only escape is Ghost/Flash. Gank when he walks up.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Bruiser items; armor boots aren't needed early.

matchups.why: Garen's Q silence stops Nasus mid-stack, and his short Q + E trades out-damage him early. Garen wins the lane and can freeze to deny the stacks Nasus needs to scale.
trading: Q silence him when he walks up to stack; a silenced Nasus can't Wither you.
E spin while he's silenced, then walk away.
Back off after short trades to let your passive regen.
If he Withers you, walk out; you lose attack speed and movement.
matchups.early: Bully him at levels 1–3 and deny Q stacks; trade every time he walks up to last-hit.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R executes him if he's low; his R makes him tankier, so time it.
matchups.wave: Freeze near your tower so he must walk up to farm.
matchups.jungle: Gank when Wither is down; your Q speed lets you chase.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Armor boots; his early damage is physical.

matchups.why: Malphite's Q poke chips Nasus as he farms, but Malphite has little kill pressure alone. Nasus farms stacks safely, so the lane is decided by jungle pressure.
trading: Q poke him whenever he walks up to stack; the speed steal makes his chase harder.
E (Ground Slam) slows his attack speed, cutting his Q damage.
Avoid extended trades; his Wither slows your attack speed and movement.
Keep your shield up before he walks up to stack.
matchups.early: Farm and poke. Neither of you can kill the other alone, so don't waste HP on long trades.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R sets up ganks. Call your jungler before his stacks grow.
matchups.wave: Slow-push so he has to farm in your Q range.
matchups.jungle: Gank when Wither is down; your R plus your jungler can kill him before his stacks matter.
matchups.build: Grasp. Armor boots and early armor items.

matchups.why: Wither slows Tryndamere's attack speed and movement, shutting down his auto-based damage. Nasus wins every trade where Wither is up, and he scales just as hard into the split-push game.
trading: Trade only when Wither is on cooldown. It slows your attack speed and movement.
Use E (Spinning Slash) to get in or out before he can Wither you.
Use Q (Bloodlust) to heal off his trades.
Back off once he's Withered you; you lose most of your damage.
matchups.early: Farm and build Fury. Trade only in his cooldown windows, after he's used Wither.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R keeps you alive in an all-in, but his R gives him HP and resists. Don't force fights.
matchups.wave: Farm under tower, then split-push the opposite side once you have items.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks when his W (Wither) is down; he can't slow your escape then.
